description: Look up one postal code at PostalCodeCheck. Their terms and API page, read on 2026-11-08, allow personal and commercial use of the keyless tier and cap it at 100 requests a day per IP. This hub caches results and keeps fresh calls under that cap for the whole service. Does not spend points and does not accept a URL. If you supply fields, the hub returns privacy_consent_required until the controller has accepted the current privacy version. Do not invent that acceptance.
name: hub_postal
